name: Colombia
summary: Colombia combines jurisprudence, provisional protection for peoples in isolation, and Indigenous governance strengthening in the Amazon.
featured_achievements: Provisional protection secured for 1.4 million hectares for the Yuri-Passé People in voluntary isolation.
The U’wa case at the Inter-American Court set a regional precedent on territorial rights.
Mataní Indigenous Territorial Council gained recognition over 887,898 hectares in the Colombian Amazon.

stories.title: Yuri-Passé provisional protection
stories.summary: ACT supported legal protection in a critical ecological corridor where uncontacted Indigenous Peoples live.

stories.title: U’wa legal victory
stories.summary: The Inter-American Court ruled in favour of the U’wa in a case over historical territorial rights violations.

stories.title: Expanded legal victories in 2024
stories.summary: Inter-American litigation outcomes and national decree pathways strengthened territorial rights implementation.

stories.title: Territorial authorities in environmental governance
stories.summary: Policy shifts in Colombia recognised Indigenous authorities in environmental regulatory roles.

quote.text: Together they integrated legal and ancestral perspectives, contributing to more culturally competent land justice.
quote.attribution: National dialogue convened by CNTI and ODTI
